_about: What the app reads for a Kit with assistants. `task_form` is the form of the kit_install approval task (tasks.get { id } -> task.form), which the approver signs; flows.kit.propose answers { ok, proposal, task, card, diff } with the same card and diff. Every `instructions_quoted` is ONE JSON-quoted string (control characters and U+2028/2029 turned to spaces, cut at 2000 characters; a cut one ends with ` [cut: N characters in all]` OUTSIDE the quotes). It is the Kit author's text: show it as plain text in its own box, never inside the card's own lines. Approve or decline through tasks.decide { id, outcome: approved | rejected | declined } (a person's own act, the presence proof rides beside the request) or, in Now, approvals.answer. kernel/flows/kits.test.js holds this file to the real installCard and diffKits.
